title: FHIR logical models
summary: The WHO SMART Trust PHW logical models (DVCMin and its PreQual and vaccine-details variants) as FHIR R5 StructureDefinitions, fetched at a pinned commit by fetch-lms, and the R5 primitive patterns. lm-derive reads them.
validatorNotApplicable: FHIR R5 StructureDefinitions compiled by SUSHI from smart-trust-phw at the commit models/fhir/SOURCE.yaml pins, and the R5 primitive regexes extracted from hl7.fhir.r5.core; their schema is FHIR R5 itself (external-schemas/hl7-fhir-r5), so a validator for them is a FHIR validator, not a Zod schema here. lm-derive refuses, in both its generate and --check modes and before writing anything, any definition that is not a kind=logical FHIR 5.0.0 model, an unknown base, a nested element, an element property, type or type profile it does not map, a choice type, an untyped element, an element-level invariant, and a model invariant it cannot translate, naming the model and element; the only way past one is an entry with a reason in tools/lm-derive/allow-unmapped.json, which is empty because these models map completely. No FHIR validator runs on them yet.
